items: jENS 2027 abstracts: the 31 March date is 2027, not 2026. Submission opened 21 July 2026 and closes 31 March 2027, so this is open now.
IMSH 2027 Call for Content closed 27 May 2026. The SimVentors Showcase is 25 January 2027 and excludes commercially available technologies.
SWPDC and AAP SOATT prize: the consortium states eligibility is limited to devices going through the FDA regulatory pathway. 2026 round still unannounced.
UCSF-Stanford PDC: the accelerator is stated as restricted to US-based applicants. Award size is up to 100K USD, not 50K. Runs twice a year.
MedTech Innovator: the 2026 cohort closed 1 December 2025, earlier than the 16 December recorded. The window has moved earlier two years running.
MEDICA competitions confirmed at 10 September 2026, 23:59 CET. MEDICA states no MDR or FDA conformity is required to enter.
IPEG 2027 confirmed as 27 to 30 April in Naples, in collaboration with ESPES and SICP. Abstract details still pending.
APSA 2027 call not yet posted. The 2026 guide appeared in August of the preceding year, so it is due imminently.
First build of the radar from the tracker sheet: 29 events, 62 ways to participate.
Deadline status computed live against today's date rather than typed by hand.

events.name: SWPDC + AAP SOATT Pediatric Device Prize
events.org: Southwest-Midwest PDC (Texas Children's / Baylor) with AAP SOATT
events.where: Virtual application; consortium in Houston, TX
events.summary: FDA P50-backed pediatric device prize of up to ~25K USD, run with the AAP Section on Advances in Therapeutics and Technology.
events.audience: Pediatric medical device innovators at any stage.

participate.label: Apply for the prize
participate.note: The consortium states eligibility is limited to devices that will go through the US FDA regulatory pathway, and that projects developing devices which do not require FDA regulation are not eligible. Application is a short questionnaire, itemised budget and an optional 1 to 2 minute video pitch.

events.name: Elevate Festival 2026 + CIX Startup Awards
events.where: Downtown Toronto, Ontario
events.summary: Canada's largest tech festival, housing the CIX Startup Awards and investor-pitch program with a health-innovation category.
events.audience: Founders and investors. CIX curates startups before 600+ investors and 94+ North American judges.

participate.label: CIX Startup Awards pitch
participate.deadlineLabel: 2026 applications closed 30 Nov 2025. 2027 cycle not announced, expected to open autumn 2026.
participate.note: Watch cixsummit.com.

events.name: EAPS 2026
events.where: Megaron Athens International Conference Centre, Athens
events.summary: Large multidisciplinary European paediatric and neonatal congress with hands-on simulation sessions. Now a commercial event after the 2025 EAPS/CEPAS split.
events.audience: Paediatricians, neonatologists, nurses, researchers, trainees.

participate.label: Team Simulation Competition
participate.deadlineLabel: Entry deadline not published. Needs verifying.
participate.note: Winning team gets free registration.

events.name: AAP National Conference & Exhibition 2026
events.where: San Diego Convention Center, San Diego, CA
events.summary: Largest annual US gathering of pediatricians and subspecialists, with the biggest pediatric tech exhibit hall.
events.audience: Pediatric clinicians, hospitalists, sim-lab and education leaders, device exhibitors.

participate.label: Attend
participate.note: 2027 edition is 15 to 19 Oct 2027 in Chicago.

participate.label: Exhibit
participate.note: SOATT innovation programming runs here.

events.name: HealthTech Innovation Days 2026
events.where: Paris. 2026 venue not confirmed.
events.summary: Two-day European healthtech partnering event: structured 1:1 meetings, roundtables, pitch sessions, investor networking.
events.audience: European healthtech, medtech and biotech companies, global investors, pharma, patient associations.

participate.label: Pitch session
participate.note: 1:1 meetings run through partneringONE.

participate.label: Attend, early bird
participate.deadlineLabel: Not yet announced. Verify on htfc-eu.com/htid.
participate.note: 2025 edition was 7 to 8 Oct 2025.

events.name: 12th Europaediatrics Congress
events.where: Venice
events.summary: Flagship triennial pan-European general paediatrics congress, with CME programme and exhibition.
events.audience: General and subspecialty paediatricians, neonatologists, researchers across Europe.

participate.label: Attend, early bird
participate.note: info@mcascientificevents.eu

events.name: The MedTech Conference 2026
events.where: Menino Convention & Exhibition Center, Boston, MA
events.summary: Leading US medical-device industry conference covering business development, capital and regulatory. Hosts the MedTech Innovator finals.
events.audience: Medtech executives, device startups, strategics and OEMs, investors, regulatory.

events.name: Georgia Tech Pediatric Innovation Day & Showcase 2026
events.where: Atlanta / Sandy Springs, GA
events.summary: Live pediatric device showcase and pitch where FDA-funded consortia award innovation prizes of ~25K USD, with an investor audience.
events.audience: Pediatric device startups pitching to investors and consortia.

participate.label: Apply to pitch
participate.deadlineLabel: 2026 deadline not announced. 2025 cycle closed ~20 Jul 2025.
participate.note: Contact tpaden3@gatech.edu.

events.name: CEPAS 2026
events.where: Lyon
events.summary: New academic paediatric congress, the society-led successor to EAPS, with a strong neonatal science base.
events.audience: Academic paediatricians, neonatologists in the ESPR community, researchers.

participate.label: Attend, early bird
participate.note: cepas@eurokongress.de

events.name: Simulation Canada SIM Expo 2026
events.where: Halifax Marriott Harbourfront Hotel, Halifax, Nova Scotia
events.summary: Canada's national healthcare simulation conference, run by Simulation Canada, formerly SIM-one / CNSH.
events.audience: Simulation educators, sim-lab directors, nurse and physician educators, vendors.

participate.label: Submit an abstract
participate.note: The tracker also records a submission deadline of 13 July. Worth settling which applies.

participate.label: Attend
participate.note: Full pass 800 CAD, 600 CAD for organisation members. Presenter registration closed 8 Jun 2026.

events.name: HLTH USA 2026
events.where: Venetian Expo, Las Vegas, NV
events.summary: One of the largest US health-innovation conferences, heavy on investors, digital health and startups.
events.audience: Healthtech founders, investors, payers, providers, executives.

participate.label: Startup Pitch
participate.note: Eligibility: founded under 4 years, raised under 8M USD. Prize 25K cash plus 25K credit.

events.name: MEDICA 2026
events.where: Messe Dusseldorf. START-UP PARK in Hall 17, Innovation Forum in Hall 12.
events.summary: World's largest medical technology and healthcare trade fair with around 5,000 exhibitors, plus START-UP PARK, pitch competitions and an investor lounge.
events.audience: Medtech and healthtech professionals, hospital buyers, distributors, corporates, investors.

participate.label: Innovation World Cup + MEDICA START-UP Competition
participate.note: Free to enter. MEDICA states conformity with the Medical Device Directive or FDA approval is not required. Categories include AI in healthcare, robotics, lab diagnostics and others. Top 12 of each competition pitch at MEDICA, 16 and 17 Nov, with 3,500 EUR in cash prizes.

participate.label: START-UP PARK booth
participate.note: EUR 2,950 plus VAT, plus EUR 550 for a pitch slot. Contact startup@medica.de.

events.name: MedTech Innovator 2027
events.dateLabel: Application window est. Nov to Dec 2026
events.where: Virtual and in-person across the US. Finals in Boston.
events.summary: World's largest medtech accelerator and pitch competition, non-dilutive, with a 350K USD grand prize. Finals sit at The MedTech Conference.
events.audience: Early to mid-stage medical device, diagnostic and digital health companies, pre-Series C, with a prototype.

participate.label: Apply to the accelerator
participate.deadlineLabel: 2027 window not yet open. Waitlist live.
participate.note: The 2026 cohort closed 1 Dec 2025 and the 2025 cohort closed 15 Jan 2025, so the window has been moving earlier. Join the waitlist at medtechinnovator.org/apply.

events.name: IMSH 2027
events.where: Ernest N. Morial Convention Center, New Orleans, LA
events.summary: World's largest scientific conference dedicated to healthcare simulation. Companies launch new products here.
events.audience: Simulation educators, sim-center directors, clinicians, technologists, mannequin and device vendors.

participate.label: Call for Content, including the SimVentor showcase
participate.note: SimVentors Showcase runs 25 Jan 2027. The category excludes commercially available technologies, and promotional material is not permitted during the showcase.

events.name: WHX Tech 2027
events.org: Informa, World Health Expo, with HIMSS
events.where: Dubai World Trade Centre, inside World Healthcare Week
events.summary: Digital-health and medtech innovation event in the Informa WHX family, formerly Arab Health, with a startup pitch competition.
events.audience: Digital-health professionals, founders, medtech manufacturers, buyers, investors.

participate.label: Xcelerate pitch competition
participate.note: USD 30,000 prize pool, around 50 pitch and 12 finalists. Shortlist end Nov 2026, grand finale 29 Jan 2027.

events.name: UCSF-Stanford PDC Pitch Competition
events.dateLabel: Runs twice a year, spring and autumn
events.where: San Francisco Bay Area, CA
events.summary: FDA-funded pediatric device consortium accelerator pitch, Shark Tank style. Accepted projects can receive a grant of up to 100K USD plus mentoring and commercialisation services.
events.audience: Pediatric medical device startups and innovators.

participate.label: Apply to pitch
participate.note: The consortium states the accelerator programme is restricted to US-based applicants, and to ideas meeting the FDA definition of a medical device. Projects at any stage may apply, with no restriction on therapeutic area.

events.name: NCC-PDI Make Your Medical Device Pitch for Kids
events.org: Children's National + University of Maryland / APDI
events.where: Washington, DC area, Children's National Hospital
events.summary: Flagship FDA-funded pediatric device pitch competition, with roughly 150K to 250K USD in FDA grants across winners.
events.audience: Pediatric medical device startups, researchers, clinician-entrepreneurs.

participate.label: Apply to pitch
participate.deadlineLabel: Main deadline not yet announced. Email apdi@childrensnational.org to join the list.
participate.note: Each cycle is themed by sector, past themes include cardiovascular, orthopaedic and spine, NICU, and remote monitoring. Applications have historically run through MedTech Innovator. Past deadlines have landed in February, April and August depending on the year.

events.name: NeoPed 2027
events.where: 2026 was Berlin. 2027 venue to be announced.
events.summary: Dedicated neonatal and paediatric medtech investment summit uniting startups, investors and clinicians. Not association-run.
events.audience: Neonatal and paediatric medtech startups, investors, clinicians.

participate.label: Pitch and investor programme
participate.deadlineLabel: 2027 dates and deadlines not yet announced
participate.note: Site is intermittently down. Verify before relying on it.

events.name: Pediatric Academic Societies Meeting 2027
events.where: Minneapolis Convention Center, Minneapolis, MN
events.summary: Largest North American general-pediatric academic meeting, with a heavy neonatology presence and 7,500+ attendees.
events.audience: Academic pediatricians, neonatologists, researchers, fellows, exhibitors.

participate.label: Exhibit
participate.note: The commercial route to neonatal clinicians and academic buyers.

events.name: IPEG 2027, 36th annual congress
events.where: Naples
events.summary: Main global meeting for minimally invasive and endoscopic pediatric surgery, held in collaboration with ESPES and SICP. Strong technical, skills and simulation focus.
events.audience: Pediatric minimally invasive surgeons, endoscopists, fellows, industry. ESPES and Italian pediatric surgery also present.

participate.label: Submit an abstract
participate.deadlineLabel: Not yet announced. IPEG states details are coming soon.

participate.label: Simulation and skills pre-courses
participate.note: A natural showcase slot.

events.name: The MedTech Forum 2027
events.where: Rotates cities. 2026 was Stockholm; 2027 host not announced.
events.summary: Largest European medtech industry conference, covering trends, innovation and regulation. No Forum-run pitch competition found.
events.audience: Industry executives, policymakers, regulators, clinicians, investors.

participate.label: Attend, early bird
participate.deadlineLabel: Not announced. 2026 early bird was 20 Mar 2026.
participate.note: For a pitch focus, MedTech World or the Informa MedTech Summit fit better.

events.name: APSA 2027, 58th annual meeting
events.where: Manchester Grand Hyatt San Diego, San Diego, CA
events.summary: Flagship US pediatric surgery meeting, with a high-fidelity hands-on simulation lab using neonatal and infant models, plus an Education & Innovation session.
events.audience: Pediatric surgeons, fellows, surgical nurses, researchers, industry exhibitors.

participate.label: Submit an abstract
participate.note: The 2026 submission guide was published in August of the preceding year, so the 2027 call is due imminently. In the 2026 cycle, authors were notified by 15 February and manuscripts ran 15 Feb to 15 Mar.

events.name: EUPSA 2027, 28th congress
events.where: Not yet announced. 2026 was the Joint Congress with IPEG and ESPES in Vienna.
events.summary: Main annual congress of European pediatric surgeons, covering the full breadth of pediatric and neonatal surgery, with pre-congress hands-on courses.
events.audience: European pediatric surgeons, trainees, nurses, industry.

events.name: ESPNIC 2027, 36th congress
events.where: Budapest
events.summary: Annual congress covering paediatric and neonatal intensive care medicine and nursing.
events.audience: Paediatric and neonatal intensivists, ICU nurses, allied professionals, researchers.

events.name: BAPS 2027, 73rd congress
events.where: Not yet announced. 2026 was Manchester, 17 to 19 Jun 2026.
events.summary: Annual international congress of pediatric surgeons of the British Isles.
events.audience: UK, Irish and international pediatric surgeons, trainees, nurses.

participate.label: Submit an abstract
participate.note: One unverified listing hinted at Aug 2027 in Lausanne.

events.name: HLTH Europe 2027
events.where: RAI Convention Centre, Amsterdam
events.summary: Europe's largest health innovation conference, spanning healthtech, digital health and medtech, with 400+ speakers from 65+ countries.
events.audience: Founders, 300+ VCs and institutional investors, providers, payers, pharma, policymakers.

participate.label: Startup Pitch Competition, EUR 30,000
participate.deadlineLabel: 2027 applications not open yet. Expected late 2026 or winter.
participate.note: Startup rate applies to companies under 5 years old that have raised under EUR 5m.

events.name: PHM 2027, Pediatric Hospital Medicine
events.where: New Orleans Marriott, New Orleans, LA
events.summary: National conference for pediatric hospitalists covering inpatient pediatric care, quality improvement and education.
events.audience: Pediatric hospitalists, inpatient and NICU-adjacent clinicians, educators.

events.name: 5th Annual Robotic Surgery for Pediatric Surgeons
events.org: Nationwide Children's Hospital, Center for Robotic Surgery
events.where: Columbus, Ohio
events.summary: Two-day conference on robotic surgery program development, clinical application presentations and case discussions, plus a clinical lab experience introducing robotic surgery to practising pediatric surgeons.
events.audience: Practising pediatric surgeons.

participate.label: Attend
participate.deadlineLabel: Not announced yet. The 2026 edition ran 19 to 21 Aug 2026.

events.name: jENS 2027, 7th joint European Neonatal Societies congress
events.org: ESPR + UENPS + GFCNI, organiser MCA Scientific Events
events.where: Bilbao
events.summary: Biennial flagship European neonatal congress, the top pan-European neonatal venue. Sits just beyond the 12-month window.
events.audience: Neonatologists, neonatal nurses, perinatal researchers, allied professionals.

participate.label: Submit an abstract
participate.note: Opened 21 Jul 2026. Structured abstract, 350 words, one table or one image. Submit via the MCA events portal. Topic list has no surgery category; General is the closest.
